_comment: Nightly Business Central -> GL Account sync. An MJ: Scheduled Jobs record run by the scheduling-engine's IntegrationSyncScheduledJobDriver, which reads Configuration.CompanyIntegrationID and calls IntegrationEngine.RunSync. Authored ACTIVE (Status=Active): it runs nightly at 02:00 UTC. Until the referenced company integration has BC credentials wired, each run completes QUIETLY as Success with 0 records -- the missing-credential error is a first-page fetch Warning, so the run is not failed and NotifyOnFailure does not fire (the error is recorded only in the run's ErrorLog). Engine computes NextRunAt from CronExpression on first poll (OwnerUserID/NextRunAt intentionally omitted -- both nullable).

fields.Name: BizApps Accounting - Nightly Business Central GL Account Sync
fields.Description: Pulls the Business Central chart of accounts into GL Accounts nightly at 02:00 UTC. Once the referenced company integration has its BC credentials wired the run pulls the chart; until then each run completes quietly as Success with 0 records, with the missing-credential error recorded only in the run's ErrorLog (no notification).
